verdict_summary: Direct architectural match for Cargonet's stack. Hands-on experience designing planner/executor/reviewer multi-agent pipelines for freight exception handling, prompt engineering, and SLM/GPT-4 cost routing.

strengths.claim: Designed planner/executor/reviewer multi-agent exception handling engine handling freight exceptions
Implemented cost-effective model routing across GPT-4 and open-weight SLMs reducing inference costs ~30%
Experience with LangChain and Pinecone vector search over carrier rate documents

gaps.claim: Vague on reviewer agent evaluation metrics, relying only on untracked override rates
Model routing was tuned heuristically as things broke rather than via rigorous evaluation benchmarks
